scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-179
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-180 classifies whether a repo-owned typed fused dense-linear consumer is a narrow safe alternative to upstream Candle output-storage APIs.
No runtime behavior changes are made in this slice.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 claim is made.

code_evidence.evidence: FeedForward::forward computes gate_proj, activation, up_proj, gated product, optional sub_layernorm, and down_proj, then returns an owned Tensor output.
The selected surface is the down_proj Tensor returned by apply_linear and optionally recorded by TransformerForwardWorkspace before qwen_trace_tensor("mlp.down_proj").
FeedForward::apply_linear can route QK256 or dense Q8 sidecar helpers, but the behavior-preserving fallback remains candle_nn::Linear::forward(input), which returns an owned Tensor.
TransformerBlock::forward consumes feed_forward_output immediately in Candle residual add (&feed_forward_output + residual), then records layer output storage boundary.
Model::forward later applies final_norm through a Candle norm op that returns an owned Tensor and records final norm output storage boundary.
Logits construction consumes normalized hidden states through lm_head/embedding matmul paths that require Tensor semantics and produce owned Tensor logits.

required_semantics_to_own.why_required: Downstream residual add and tracing require the down_proj output Tensor shape, dtype, and device to match Candle semantics.
Existing diagnostic trace can record mlp.down_proj before residual add; a fused consumer must preserve trace identity or explicitly provide an equivalent receipt-safe trace surface.
TransformerForwardWorkspace records the selected output-storage boundary from the down_proj Tensor.
The next operation is Candle Tensor add between feed_forward_output and residual; a fused consumer must preserve Candle broadcasting, dtype, device, and aliasing behavior.
The block output is traced, used as source evidence, and becomes the next layer input or final model state.
Avoiding returned Tensor materialization would require the next layer norm or final norm to consume the fused output without changing math.
Strict before/after receipts and optional checkpoints must preserve generated IDs, decoded text, and any dense hook identity.

feasibility_classification.reason: A narrow dense-linear fused consumer cannot stop at feed_forward.down_proj.output because the next required behavior is Candle residual add and then norm/attention or final norm Tensor consumers. Owning enough downstream semantics to avoid returned Tensor materialization would cross from a dense-linear output-storage optimization into residual-add, norm, trace/workspace, and model.forward Tensor identity changes.
why_not_local_runtime_gate: The fused consumer would need to replace or wrap residual add, not only dense-linear output.
The fused consumer would need to preserve qwen_trace and workspace boundary identity for both down_proj output and block output.
The fused consumer would need a Tensor-compatible handoff into next-layer norm/final norm or else fuse additional model stages.
The required semantic surface is broader than SLM-CPU-179's dense-linear caller-output-storage gate.

required_evidence_before_reconsidering: An output-storage API for Candle matmul and residual add, or a repo-owned typed Tensor view that can safely hand off to residual add and norm consumers.
A fail-closed comparator proving Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0 generated IDs and decoded text remain unchanged.
Receipt fields naming the selected dense-linear output-storage or fused-consumer path.
Allocation counters for feed_forward.down_proj.output, residual add, and model.forward before any allocation-reduction claim.
Phase timing fields for affected warm-session prompts before any timing claim.

runtime_status_after_slm_cpu_180.selected_next_frontier_reason: The narrow repo-owned fused dense consumer is not a safe next runtime candidate; future work should either track/adopt real Candle output-storage APIs or explicitly defer this branch and return to another measured Kaby performance frontier.

must_not_claim: SLM-CPU-180 enables dense-linear caller-output storage by default.
SLM-CPU-180 implements or selects a typed fused dense consumer.
SLM-CPU-180 proves allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, or sustained throughput.
Candle Tensor matmul, broadcast_add, final-norm, residual-add, output-head, or model.forward caller-output-storage blockers are resolved.
Packed-Q8 or source-order sidecar paths are promoted to default runtime.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
